revision: BodyV6.9 ECO r5 - populated fit model

inputs.component_models: 3d/main-populated-native.step (KiCad 10.0.4 native export of models/) and the r4 encoder export; C52/C53 DNP have no model
inputs.board_bodies: 1.0 mm nominal prisms rebuilt from Edge.Cuts with NPTH holes

frame: BodyV6.9.step coordinates: X = u - 28, Z = 47.5 - v, Y = board normal, F (battery/back) side toward -Y

board_pose.main: B face Y=9.275 (pillar seats), F face Y=8.275; X=u-28, Z=47.5-v
board_pose.encoder: B face Y=3.5 (case post shoulders), F face Y=2.5; can float 0.2 mm toward the cover bosses (top Y=2.3)

case_solid_naming: Fusion export is one part with 9 solids; names are interpretations by bounding box (Case, Wheel, 4 side buttons, 2 front buttons, BackCover). Note: in BodyV6.9 the two front-button solids are listed in the opposite order to BodyV6, so FrontButton_1/2 are swapped relative to the r4 report.

intersections.interpretation: USB-C shell vs the case opening corners: same 0.16 mm3 as r3/r4; unchanged
wheel shaft inside the encoder hollow-shaft bore: the intended press-fit; same 0.62 mm3 as r3/r4

UNCHANGED from r4: the encoder body (2.86 mm below the encoder-board F face at Y 2.5) passes through the full 1.0 mm back-cover plate over u 44.6-50.4 / v 6.15-12.0 and protrudes 0.35 mm beyond the outer cover face. BodyV6.9 still has no opening or pocket there.

findings: No new interference against BodyV6.9. The new top-edge notch clears the seat block; the removed right-pillar notch is fully under the new ring seat.
C11 0.43 mm, R7 0.54 mm from the relocated B-side post (were 0.04 / 0.03 mm to the old post in r4). C12 now 5 mm north of U1 (bulk 10 uF; the 1 uF C11 stays 3.5 mm from U1).
Pillars grew to dia 3.75: Y1 body 0.54 mm (was 0.61) from the BR pillar; R39 0.25 mm (was 0.33) from the grown BR seat; the dia 4.0 notches have 0.125 mm radial clearance.
ENC1 vs BackCover 15.9 mm3: still open (see intersections).
Encoder board vs Wheel 0 mm (hub underside on the B face) and vs BackCover 0.2 mm: as in r4.
Side switches SW1/SW2/SW5/SW6 0.06 mm to the side-button bodies and 0.69 mm to the case guides; SW3/SW4 0.89 mm to the front-button caps: as before.
limitations: Static nominal assembly; no button travel, no display module, no battery, no cable, no fasteners.
Component geometry is the release model set (vendor CAD where registered, otherwise labelled envelopes).
Boolean interference threshold 1e-4 mm3; clearances reported only below 1.5 mm.

outputs.3d/main-populated-bodyv6.9.step: main board + 120 fitted components in the BodyV6.9 frame
outputs.3d/encoder-populated-bodyv6.9.step: encoder board + ENC1 + J1 (same as r4, same frame)
outputs.3d/bodyv6.9-fit-assembly.step: BodyV6.9 case solids + both populated boards
